title: AllAdvancements
description: A fully configurable Minecraft challenge plugin where players must collect every advancement in Minecraft 1.21.
body:
# AllAdvancementsV3

AllAdvancementsV3 brings the ultimate advancement hunting challenge to Minecraft!

The goal is simple:
Complete every single advancement available in Minecraft 1.21.

Perfect for SMPs, challenge servers, YouTube content, hardcore worlds, and community events. The plugin tracks player progress and turns advancements into a full survival challenge experience.

## Features

* Complete advancement challenge system
* Supports Minecraft 1.21 advancements
* Live progress tracking
* Scoreboard support
* Fully configurable
* Performance optimized
* No watermarks
* Adjustable messages and settings
* Modern and clean design
* Stable and efficient code
* Easy setup

## Gameplay

Players must unlock every advancement available in Minecraft 1.21.

As players progress:

* advancements are tracked automatically
* the scoreboard updates live
* completion percentages increase
* players work toward 100% completion

## Included Systems

### Advancement Tracking

Automatically tracks completed advancements.

### Progress System

Displays challenge progression and statistics.

### Scoreboard Support

Live advancement progress shown directly in-game.

### Challenge Support

Perfect for competitive and survival-based gameplay.

## Why Choose AllAdvancementsV3?

* Perfect for SMP challenges
* Great for YouTube and streaming content
* Encourages exploration and progression
* Lightweight and optimized
* Modern and reliable systems
* Designed for Minecraft 1.21

## Use Cases

* SMP Challenges
* Hardcore Survival
* YouTube Series
* Community Competitions
* Achievement Hunting
* Adventure Servers
